data.name: Bhajanlal
data.gender_notes: Bhajanlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to singing the praises of a deity. Derived from Bhajana (to sing the praises of a deity) and Lal (beloved). The name Bhajanlal carries the meaning “Devotee of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhajanlal usually hope their child will grow to embody devotee of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies deep devotion and dedication to a deity.
data.etymology: Bhajanlal belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devotee of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhajanlal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Bhajanlal' holds significant importance in the Hindu culture, as it denotes an ardent devotee who is deeply committed to the worship of a deity. The word 'bhajana' itself signifies the act of chanting hymns or praises in honor of a Hindu god or goddess. Bhajans are an integral part of Hindu tradition and are considered a powerful way to connect with the divine. The term is often used to describe individuals who have devoted their lives to the practice of singing or composing bhajans, inspiring spiritual growth and unity within the community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Bhajanlal' carries a profound spiritual significance, as it encapsulates the essence of devotion and dedication to a higher power. The term 'bhajan' is used to describe not only the act of singing praises but also the inner feeling of love and surrender to the divine. The suffix 'Lal' in the name further amplifies this spiritual sentiment, emphasizing the beloved nature of the deity and the deep attachment and devotion of the bearer towards the divine. Therefore, a person named Bhajanlal is seen as a devoted soul who has a genuine love and commitment towards his or her deity, inspiring others to seek spiritual growth and connection through devotional practices.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhajanlal: Dedicated to the divine through devotional songs. His soul is immersed in the blissful melody of God's name.

historical_references.reference: The name Bhajanlal has been used throughout Hindu history by sages, scholars, and devotees who exemplified its meaning.
